items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He said Eddie Dorsey is alive yet. No. He said Eddie Dorsey not dead. No, I thought he was dead.

ctx.x: Yeah, but Eddie Dorsey is alive. Yeah, he used to play bass two-by-two.
Tell him Eddie Dorsey is alive. He said Eddie Dorsey is alive yet. No. He said Eddie Dorsey not dead. No, I thought he was dead.
Eddie Dorsey plays bass. The real bright fella.
